operations.desired_consequence: Jacob can explicitly delegate an entire project through operate-project in Croki, see the consequence, evidence, active work, required judgment, and verified outcome, while the selected native harness owns operation and project truth remains recoverable without Croki.
failure_conditions: Croki becomes the required runtime, canonical memory, or authority source.
Ordinary bounded requests acquire project-operation ceremony or hidden behavior.
Croki duplicates provider planning, delegation, product judgment, or operate-project state.
The product exposes runtime machinery instead of the exact consequence and judgment.
Existing user work is overwritten or a claimed outcome lacks observable proof.
proof_required: A fresh supported harness can explicitly invoke operate-project and recover the active project consequence without a Croki-authored behavior prompt.
Croki projects useful operation state from canonical project-local runtime data and can rebuild after disconnection without becoming its owner.
The first shipped path is exercised in the rendered product with focused automated tests and honest failure states.
The project remains operable and runtime validation succeeds with Croki absent.
operations.title: Make Croki the operating environment for native harnesses
